theme.en: AI Expansion Meets Manufacturing and Deployment Friction
theme.zh: AI扩张遭遇制造与部署阻力

dek.en: Terafab's reported wafer targets highlight the scale of planned supply, while a reported Micron construction pause and local data-center votes expose obstacles to expansion. Cooling materials and memory integration offer technical routes through constraints inside the hardware stack.
dek.zh: Terafab据报提出的大规模晶圆产能目标，展现了供给扩张的雄心；美光厂房工程据报暂停、美国地方数据中心公投则揭示了扩张面临的阻力。散热材料与存储集成技术，为缓解硬件内部瓶颈提供了新的路径。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia Board Opens Inquiry Into Reports Concerning Jensen Huang
title.zh: 英伟达董事会就涉及黄仁勋的报道展开调查

summary.en: Nvidia's board is investigating reports concerning CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship with a client, Tom's Hardware reports. The board says it retains confidence in Huang and the leadership team. The inquiry adds a governance issue for the AI accelerator supplier, with the underlying allegations still under investigation.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，英伟达董事会正在调查有关CEO黄仁勋据称与一名客户存在私人关系的报道。董事会表示，仍对黄仁勋及管理团队抱有信心。这为这家AI加速器供应商增加了公司治理层面的议题，相关指控仍有待调查。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Terafab Reportedly Targets 700,000 Memory Wafers per Month
title.zh: Terafab据报将存储晶圆月产能目标定为70万片

summary.en: Terafab is targeting memory production capacity of about 700,000 wafers per month, Wccftech reports. The Tesla-SpaceX venture has reportedly told suppliers it aims for total capacity of roughly 1 million wafers per month by 2032, supporting its planned memory and logic supply. These are long-term capacity targets; realized chip output will depend on construction, equipment installation and yields.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，Terafab将存储晶圆月产能目标定为约70万片。这个由Tesla与SpaceX推动的项目据报已向供应商提出，到2032年实现约100万片晶圆的总月产能，以支持其存储与逻辑芯片供应规划。这些属于长期产能目标，实际芯片产出仍取决于厂房建设、设备安装与良率。

title.en: TSMC's BEOL Memory Work Points Toward Logic-Level Integration
title.zh: 台积电BEOL存储研发指向逻辑芯片内部集成

summary.en: TSMC is developing back-end-of-line memory that could use the processor die's footprint for additional storage, Wccftech reports. Integrating memory into the interconnect stack offers a route to placing more storage close to compute. The commercial value of that approach depends on achievable density, device characteristics and integration cost.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，台积电正在研发后道互连层（BEOL）存储技术，可利用处理器裸片的面积布置额外存储。将存储集成到互连堆栈，为在计算单元附近增加存储容量提供了一条路径。其商业价值取决于最终能够实现的密度、器件特性与集成成本。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Micron Reportedly Pauses Work on $4.5 Billion Taiwan Plant
title.zh: 美光据报因劳资纠纷暂停45亿美元台湾厂房工程

summary.en: Micron has reportedly paused work on a $4.5 billion plant in Taiwan following a labor dispute, according to The Edge Malaysia. A construction interruption could put pressure on the project's schedule and the timing of future capacity availability. The reported pause concerns plant work; its eventual effect on production depends on how long the dispute lasts.
summary.zh: 据The Edge Malaysia报道，美光因劳资纠纷，暂停了一座投资额45亿美元的台湾厂房工程。施工中断可能影响项目进度，以及未来产能投入使用的时间。此次报道涉及厂房工程暂停，对后续生产的实际影响仍取决于纠纷持续多久。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Diamond Foundry Produces 200mm Single-Crystal Diamond Wafer
title.zh: Diamond Foundry制成200mm单晶金刚石晶圆

summary.en: Diamond Foundry has produced a 200mm single-crystal diamond wafer intended for semiconductor cooling, Tom's Hardware reports. The material is designed to remove heat and suppress hotspots on AI processors, addressing a constraint that becomes more demanding as power density rises. Its usefulness in deployed systems will depend on integration and manufacturing economics alongside thermal performance.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，Diamond Foundry已制成一片面向半导体散热的200mm单晶金刚石晶圆。该材料旨在导出AI处理器热量并抑制热点，回应功率密度上升带来的散热压力。其在实际系统中的应用价值，还取决于集成方式、制造成本与热性能的综合表现。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: U.S. Voters Back Data-Center Restrictions in 40 of 41 Local Measures
title.zh: 美国41项地方公投中有40项支持限制数据中心开发

summary.en: U.S. voters favored restrictions on data-center development in 40 of 41 local ballot measures during the November 3 midterm elections, Wccftech reports. The results point to local approval and siting as potential constraints on AI infrastructure deployment. The count covers those local measures, and does not establish a nationwide restriction on data-center construction.
summary.zh: 据Wccftech报道，在11月3日中期选举涉及的41项地方公投中，选民在40项公投中支持限制数据中心开发。这表明地方审批与选址可能成为AI基础设施部署的约束。该统计反映这些地方议案的投票结果，本身并不意味着美国实施全国性的数据中心建设限制。

title.en: Investigation Questions U.S. H200 Approvals for Chinese Buyers
title.zh: 调查质疑美国向部分中国买家批准H200交易的审查机制

summary.en: An investigation cited by Wccftech alleges that U.S. regulators approved Nvidia H200 transactions involving Chinese firms operating from deserted offices and linked to sanctioned military suppliers. The findings raise questions about end-user screening in the export-approval process. They add scrutiny to licensing decisions, while any resulting change in policy remains uncertain.
summary.zh: Wccftech援引的一项调查称，美国监管部门曾批准涉及部分中国企业的英伟达H200交易，而这些企业的办公地点空置，并与受制裁的军方供应商存在关联。这些调查指称使出口审批中的最终用户审查机制受到质疑。相关许可决定面临更严格审视，但是否会因此调整政策仍不确定。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: Samsung's Cash Holdings Exceed $146 Billion as Chip Demand Rises
title.zh: 芯片需求上升之际，三星现金持有量超过1460亿美元

summary.en: Samsung Electronics' cash holdings have exceeded $146 billion as chip demand rises, UPI reports. The balance gives the company financial capacity to support manufacturing investment and absorb large spending commitments. Its effect on chip supply depends on subsequent capital-allocation decisions and project execution.
summary.zh: 据UPI报道，随着芯片需求上升，三星电子的现金持有量已超过1460亿美元。这笔资金为制造投资和大额支出安排提供了财务支持。其对芯片供给的影响，仍取决于后续资本配置决策与项目执行情况。

title.en: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor Guides December-Quarter Revenue to $170–190 Million
title.zh: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor预计12月季度营收为1.7亿至1.9亿美元

summary.en: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor expects revenue of $170 million to $190 million for the December quarter, TokenPost reports. The range provides a near-term sales benchmark for the power-semiconductor supplier. It is forward guidance, with actual performance still dependent on orders and shipments during the quarter.
summary.zh: 据TokenPost报道，Alpha and Omega Semiconductor预计，截至12月的季度营收为1.7亿至1.9亿美元。该区间为观察这家功率半导体供应商的短期销售表现提供了参考。这属于前瞻性业绩指引，实际表现仍取决于季度内的订单与出货情况。

theme.en: Locality and Scheduling Turn Hardware Capacity Into Throughput
theme.zh: 数据局部性与调度将硬件能力转化为吞吐量

dek.en: This week's selected preprints examine how die placement, precision delivery and communication scheduling affect realized performance. GPU measurements, a Tensix simulator and circuit-partitioning results connect software execution choices to hardware constraints.
dek.zh: 本期预印本关注裸片间的数据放置、精度数据传输和通信调度如何影响实际性能。GPU实测、Tensix模拟器与电路划分结果，从不同层面揭示软件执行方式与硬件约束之间的联系。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Characterizing CUDA Locality Domains on Blackwell GPUs
title.zh: Blackwell GPU上CUDA局部性域的性能特征分析

papers.authors: Rocky Wang, Joyce Zhou, Keith Jiang, et al.

summary.en: Measurements on an eight-B300 node show that CUDA 13.4 Locality Domains can improve performance through die-aware placement and execution, with reported speedups up to 43.5% for NCCL AllGather and 37% for DeepGEMM EP. The study also identifies allocation overhead above 32 MB associated with barriers and TLB invalidation. These preprint results make cross-die locality a concrete tuning consideration, with gains dependent on access patterns and workload.
summary.zh: 在配备8颗B300的节点上，研究通过感知裸片位置的数据放置与执行方式，评估CUDA 13.4局部性域，报告NCCL AllGather和DeepGEMM EP的最高性能提升分别为43.5%和37%。研究还发现，超过32 MB的内存分配存在与屏障和TLB失效相关的额外开销。这些预印本实测结果说明，跨裸片局部性已成为具体的调优因素，但收益取决于访问模式和工作负载。

title.en: Wolfpine: A RISC-V Simulator for Tenstorrent Tensix
title.zh: Wolfpine：面向Tenstorrent Tensix的RISC-V模拟器

summary.en: Wolfpine simulates Tenstorrent's Wormhole and Blackhole Tensix architectures in Python and integrates with TT-Metal. Built from public documentation, open software and hardware measurements, it provides component tracing, typed events and timeline export for investigating execution bottlenecks. The preprint lowers the barrier to architecture exploration, while timing fidelity is added incrementally through an optional cost model.
summary.zh: Wolfpine以Python模拟Tenstorrent的Wormhole与Blackhole两代Tensix架构，并与TT-Metal集成。它基于公开文档、开源软件和硬件测量构建，提供组件追踪、类型化事件和时间线导出，便于定位执行瓶颈。该预印本工具降低了架构探索门槛，时序精度则通过可选的成本模型逐步补充。

title.en: AI Models & Inference Systems
title.zh: AI模型与推理系统

title.en: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
title.zh: StrataFlux：利用存储层次结构的低比特大模型推理

papers.authors: Jake Hyun, Ziyu Zhao, Jae-sun Seo, et al.

summary.en: StrataFlux streams selected precision refinements from host RAM and SSDs to improve low-bit weights and KV caches while overlapping transfers with computation. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights on RTX 5090, it reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while retaining 95.4% of the quantized baseline's throughput. The preprint shows how the memory hierarchy can recover quantization quality, with the throughput result tied to the reported model and platform.
summary.zh: StrataFlux从主机内存与SSD中选择性传输用于精度修正的数据，并将传输与计算重叠，以改善低比特权重和KV缓存的精度。在RTX 5090上，针对采用2比特权重的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，它将WikiText-2困惑度从9.46降至8.40，同时保留量化基线95.4%的吞吐量。该预印本展示了利用存储层次结构弥补量化精度损失的路径，上述吞吐表现对应其报告的特定模型与平台。

title.en: ZYFA: Speed and Accuracy of FP8 FlashAttention on AMD CDNA4
title.zh: ZYFA：AMD CDNA4上FP8 FlashAttention的速度与精度优化

papers.authors: Quentin Anthony, Ganesh Bikshandi, Praneeth Medepalli, et al.

summary.en: ZYFA develops MI355X prefill kernels that combine direct FP8 probability computation, ping-pong scheduling of softmax and matrix multiplication, and power-of-two probability scaling. The motivation is a measured utilization gap: at 32K tokens, the cited AITER kernels reach 39% of peak FP8 matrix throughput versus 49% in BF16. The preprint addresses vector-unit work and instruction ordering that limit attention performance, so the headline FP8 arithmetic advantage alone is insufficient to predict speed.
summary.zh: ZYFA面向MI355X开发prefill内核，将直接计算FP8概率、交替执行softmax与矩阵乘法的乒乓调度，以及按2的幂缩放概率结合起来。其出发点是实测利用率差距：在32K token下，文中引用的AITER内核达到FP8矩阵峰值吞吐的39%，BF16则为49%。该预印本针对限制注意力性能的向量单元计算与指令排序开销展开优化，表明仅凭FP8算术峰值优势不足以预测实际速度。

title.en: KOSMOS: Self-Scheduling Persistent Kernels for Communication-Compute Overlap
title.zh: KOSMOS：以自调度常驻内核实现通信与计算重叠

papers.authors: Alexander Magro, Aristotle Martin, Ye Wang, et al.

summary.en: KOSMOS lets GPU workgroups switch between communication and computation as data becomes ready, using consumer-demand-ordered queues inside persistent kernels. On MI350X and MI355X, the preprint reports 1.10–1.28× end-to-end BF16 TP+SP training speedups in Megatron-LM and 1.29–1.83× speedups over DeepEP for DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen3-235B proxy workloads. The contribution targets idle gaps from fixed schedules; the MoE results apply to the evaluated proxy training configurations.
summary.zh: KOSMOS在常驻内核中按消费者需求组织队列，使GPU工作组随数据就绪情况，在通信与计算任务之间切换。该预印本在MI350X和MI355X上报告，Megatron-LM的BF16张量并行加序列并行训练端到端加速为1.10至1.28倍；针对DeepSeek-V3与Qwen3-235B的代理工作负载，相对DeepEP加速1.29至1.83倍。其贡献在于减少固定调度造成的空闲间隙，MoE性能数字对应所评估的代理训练配置。

title.en: FastAFD Measures Attention-FFN Disaggregation on Rack-Scale NVLink
title.zh: FastAFD评估机架级NVLink上的Attention与FFN解耦

papers.authors: Yichao Fu, Yuxuan Zhang, Minshen Zhang, et al.

summary.en: FastAFD separates attention and MoE expert execution on GB200 NVL72 and overlaps the work of two microbatches. Against the best tested vLLM wide-expert-parallel configuration, it reaches up to 1.17× throughput on Qwen3 and 1.16× on Qwen3.5, while matching the baseline on MiniMax-M2.5. An analytical model predicts throughput within 3% in the reported evaluation, offering a pre-deployment check of whether disaggregation pays for a particular workload.
summary.zh: FastAFD在GB200 NVL72上分离注意力与MoE专家执行，并将两个微批次的工作重叠。相对测试中最优的vLLM大规模专家并行配置，Qwen3和Qwen3.5的最高吞吐提升分别为1.17倍和1.16倍，MiniMax-M2.5则与基线持平。文中分析模型在所报告评估中的吞吐预测误差不超过3%，可用于在部署前判断特定工作负载是否适合解耦。

title.en: NUMA-Torch: Compiler-Driven NUMA-Aware LLM Prefill on Multi-Socket CPUs
title.zh: NUMA-Torch：以编译器优化多路CPU上的NUMA感知大模型prefill

papers.authors: Thisara Rathnayaka Weerakoon, Ishan Dewpura, Niman Ransindu, et al.

summary.en: NUMA-Torch makes TorchInductor partition weights and compute by CPU socket, keeping thread pools and memory allocations local through CPU affinity. The approach targets cross-socket weight traffic that reduces effective DRAM bandwidth during prefill. The preprint evaluates GPT-2 variants from 117M to 762M parameters and BERT Small and Large, so extrapolating its findings to much larger models requires further measurement.
summary.zh: NUMA-Torch改造TorchInductor，按CPU插槽划分权重与计算，并通过CPU亲和性将线程池和内存分配限制在本地。该方法针对prefill阶段跨插槽读取权重、导致有效DRAM带宽下降的问题。预印本评估了参数量从1.17亿到7.62亿的GPT-2变体，以及BERT Small和Large，将结论推广到更大模型仍需要进一步测量。

title.en: FastKVComp Raises KV Compression Throughput for Disaggregated Serving
title.zh: FastKVComp提升解耦推理服务的KV缓存压缩吞吐量

papers.authors: Junhong Wu, Zedong Liu, Xinyang Ma, et al.

summary.en: FastKVComp fuses distribution transformation and low-bit quantization in a TileLang kernel and replaces KVServe's lossless backend with a searchable compression pipeline. The preprint reports up to 5.9× speedup for the fused kernel and lossless-compression throughput rising from below 90 GB/s to over 500 GB/s. Faster compression can preserve the benefit of reduced KV transfers on high-bandwidth links, although these component metrics do not establish the same gain in end-to-end serving throughput.
summary.zh: FastKVComp以TileLang内核融合分布变换与低比特量化，并为KVServe换用可搜索的无损压缩流水线。该预印本报告融合内核最高加速5.9倍，无损压缩吞吐量从不足90 GB/s提升至超过500 GB/s。更快的压缩有助于在高带宽互连下保留减少KV传输的收益，但这些组件指标并不代表端到端推理吞吐量也有同等提升。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: FRESHPart: Feedback-Reshaped Spectral Embedding for Hypergraph Partitioning
title.zh: FRESHPart：通过反馈重塑谱嵌入的超图划分方法

papers.authors: Rongjian Liang, Zhuo Feng, Brucek Khailany

summary.en: FRESHPart uses geometry and search feedback to reshape spectral embeddings for circuit-hypergraph partitioning. On Titan23, the preprint reports average cut reductions relative to hMETIS of 13.09% at 2% imbalance tolerance and 25.21% at 20%, completing each benchmark in under 120 seconds on one GPU. The result offers a practical EDA partitioning improvement; the reported metric is partition cut quality rather than final placed-and-routed chip performance.
summary.zh: FRESHPart利用几何反馈与搜索反馈重塑谱嵌入，改进电路超图划分。在Titan23基准上，该预印本报告：不平衡容限为2%和20%时，相对hMETIS的平均割代价分别降低13.09%和25.21%，每项基准均在单颗GPU上于120秒内完成。结果为EDA划分提供了实用改进，其指标衡量划分质量，尚不能直接推导最终布局布线后的芯片性能。
